# Repository Instructions

Before changing code, read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for the project-wide rules and generated Next.js constraints.

Follow the applicable file-scoped guidance in `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md`; each file declares its `applyTo` pattern in frontmatter.

The project-specific guides cover:
- [Next.js conventions](instructions/nextjs-conventions.instructions.md)
- [TypeScript and React](instructions/typescript-react.instructions.md)
- [Styling and UI](instructions/styling-ui.instructions.md)
- [Database](instructions/database.instructions.md)
- [Authentication](instructions/auth.instructions.md)
- [Data fetching](instructions/data-fetching.instructions.md)

Run `npm run lint` after code changes.
